summary: Technical & compliance revision plan for QURAN LAYER. Resolves the PNG transparency export by separating the editor checkerboard from the export canvas, implementing a zero-background SVG foreignObject/canvas rasterization pipeline with alpha verification, curating classical Uthmanic Arabic typography (Amiri Quran, Scheherazade New, Noto Naskh) under SIL OFL, and adding a dedicated Open-Source & Attribution modal.
